subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): expose anonymous Talk activity to plugins

question: Should process-wide anonymous Talk activity be available to every Plugin SDK consumer, or only to plugins that explicitly receive a trusted, declared capability?
rationale: The code can sanitize event contents, but only maintainers can set the intended privacy and trust contract for cross-plugin observation and the long-lived public SDK surface.

options.title: Require a declared capability
options.body: Add an explicit manifest or trusted-runtime capability and expose `onActivity` only to plugins granted that process-wide observation contract.

options.title: Keep it owner-scoped
options.body: Do not publish the observer through the general SDK; retain it behind an internal or companion-plugin-specific boundary until a broader plugin contract is approved.

options.title: Accept universal observation
options.body: Document that all loaded plugins may observe anonymous gateway-wide Talk timing and accept the resulting privacy and future compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Require a declared capability
recommendation.body: Add an explicit manifest or trusted-runtime capability and expose `onActivity` only to plugins granted that process-wide observation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged Talk-harness work and the proposed public activity contract, so they are the strongest available technical routing candidate.
